title: Binary Symmetric Channel
text: Introduce binary errors, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Error probability} sets the probability of error occurrence, {Output error vector} sets the option to output error locations, {Initial seed} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Binary output signal column vector | matrix

params.name: Output error vector
params.values: Option to output error locations on (default) | off

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | boolean

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
